npcmaker.help.editor.template: The template this NPC uses, and how many NPCs nearby share it.
npcmaker.help.editor.template.more:
Every NPC is placed from a template (a file in the world's npcmaker/npcs folder). NPCs sharing a template look and act the same.
When you save, you choose whether to change the template for all of them or give just this NPC its own copy.
npcmaker.help.editor.preview: A live preview of the NPC as you change it.
npcmaker.help.editor.preview.more: Shows the skin, mob look, size, name colour and idle pose. Use "Preview the next emote" on the Animation tab to watch emotes here.
npcmaker.help.editor.save: Save your changes (you'll pick who they apply to).
npcmaker.help.editor.save.more:
Saving asks: update every NPC using this template, or only this NPC (it gets its own copy of the template, e.g. baker_2).
Click your choice twice to confirm, so nobody changes other NPCs by accident.
npcmaker.help.editor.close: Close the editor. With unsaved changes, click twice to throw them away.
npcmaker.help.editor.scope.all: Change the template, so every NPC using it updates.
npcmaker.help.editor.scope.only: Give only this NPC its own copy of the template, with these changes.
npcmaker.help.editor.mobpicker: Type to search every mob in the game and your mods; click one to use its look.
npcmaker.help.editor.tab.look: Look: name, skin, mob look, arms and size.
npcmaker.help.editor.tab.stats: Stats: health, strength, armour, speed, knockback resistance.
npcmaker.help.editor.tab.behaviour: Behaviour: AI template, moving around, fighting, respawning.
npcmaker.help.editor.tab.rules: AI rules: "when this happens, if that's true, do this" rows.
npcmaker.help.editor.tab.rules.more:
Rules make NPCs react: flee when hurt, greet players, light torches at night, go home when it rains.
They're checked twice a second, top to bottom. For moving (flee, go home, follow…) the first matching rule wins; everything else (say, sounds, particles, animations…) fires whenever it matches, at most once per its cooldown.
npcmaker.help.editor.tab.gear: Gear: what the NPC wears and holds.
npcmaker.help.editor.tab.inventory: Inventory: items the NPC carries and uses (potions, food, arrows, torches, spare weapons).
npcmaker.help.editor.tab.factions: Factions: which groups this NPC belongs to (friends, enemies, reputation).
npcmaker.help.editor.tab.sounds: Sounds: idle, greeting, hurt and death sounds, talking blips, and speech bubbles.
npcmaker.help.editor.tab.animation: Animation: idle pose, emotes, particle aura and event effects.
npcmaker.help.editor.tab.dialogue: Dialogue: the NPC's conversation, edited as a graph of boxes and arrows.
npcmaker.help.editor.tab.quests: Quests: the quests this NPC gives, and the quest builder.
npcmaker.help.editor.tab.location: Location: where this NPC stands and which way it faces (only this NPC).
npcmaker.help.editor.tab.library: Library: upload your own sounds, particles, Blockbench models and animations.
npcmaker.help.editor.tab.live: Live: every NPC loaded right now, in every world. Find them, go to them, edit or remove them.
npcmaker.help.live.search: Type part of a name or template to narrow the list.
npcmaker.help.live.row: A loaded NPC: its name, health, where it is, and its template. Gold means it uses the template you're editing.
npcmaker.help.live.row.more: Your own world comes first, nearest first. NPCs in chunks nobody is near aren't loaded, so they don't show until someone goes there. The list refreshes every 2 seconds.
npcmaker.help.live.find: Make this NPC glow through walls for you for 30 seconds, and show which way it is.
npcmaker.help.live.find.more: Only you see the glow. It shows once the NPC is within your render distance; farther away, the message says how far and which way to go.
npcmaker.help.live.go: Teleport to this NPC, even in another world.
npcmaker.help.live.edit: Open this NPC in the editor.
npcmaker.help.live.remove: Remove this NPC from the world. Click twice: it doesn't respawn.
npcmaker.help.live.refresh: Ask the server for the list again now.
npcmaker.help.editor.library.open: Open the custom content library to upload, listen to and delete files.
npcmaker.help.editor.library.open.more: Files you upload are kept in the world and sent to every player's game automatically (no resource pack hosting needed). They then appear in the sound, particle, mob-look and animation pickers, marked with ★.
npcmaker.help.library.kind.sound: Sounds: .ogg files (Ogg Vorbis, up to 4 MB each).
npcmaker.help.library.kind.sound.more: Use them anywhere a sound is picked: idle and greeting sounds, talking blips, rules and dialogue. Their id is npcmaker_custom:<name>. Audacity can export .ogg.
npcmaker.help.library.kind.particle: Particles: .png pictures (up to 32). A tall strip of square frames animates.
npcmaker.help.library.kind.particle.more: A 16×64 picture becomes 4 frames played over the particle's life. Particles drift up gently and fade out. Use them for auras, event effects, rules and dialogue.
npcmaker.help.library.kind.model: Models: Blockbench Bedrock models (.geo.json) with a .png texture of the same name.
npcmaker.help.library.kind.model.more: In Blockbench make a "Bedrock Entity" model with Box UV, then File → Export → Export Bedrock Geometry, and save the texture as a PNG with the same name (baker.geo.json + baker.png). Upload both together. Pick it in Look → Looks like. A bone named "head" follows where the NPC looks; animations named …idle and …walk play by themselves.
npcmaker.help.library.kind.animation.mor: Export with Animation → Export Animations. They play on custom models (by bone name) and on player-shaped NPCs (bones named head, body, rightArm, leftArm, rightLeg, leftLeg). Use them as emotes, idle poses, from rules and dialogue.
npcmaker.help.library.list: The files of this kind on the server.
npcmaker.help.library.delete: Delete this file for everyone (click twice). NPCs using it fall back to the default.
npcmaker.help.library.upload: Choose files to upload (you can pick several). Or drop files on this screen.
npcmaker.help.library.upload.more: Accepted: .ogg sounds, .png pictures (a model's texture if named like a model, otherwise a particle), .geo.json models and .animation.json animations.
npcmaker.help.field.name: The name shown above the NPC's head and in conversations.
npcmaker.help.field.appearance.name_colo: Name colour as a hex code, like #C8A24A (gold). The square shows it.
npcmaker.help.field.appearance.show_name: Show or hide the name above the NPC's head.
npcmaker.help.field.appearance.model: Turn the NPC into any mob (spider, copper golem, modded mobs…) or keep the player model.
npcmaker.help.field.appearance.model.mor:
Click to search every living mob from the game and your mods, plus your own Blockbench models (★, from the Library tab). The NPC keeps its own AI, dialogue and quests; only the look changes.
Pick "Player" to go back to a skin.
npcmaker.help.field.appearance.skin_file: A skin from this world's skin library. Click to step through them.
Upload skins with the button below (or drop a PNG on the editor). Everyone on the server sees them, no skin websites needed.
npcmaker.help.field.upload: Upload a skin PNG from your computer (or drag one onto the editor).
npcmaker.help.field.upload.more: Standard 64×64 Minecraft skins. It's added to the world's shared skin library and selected for this NPC. Save to keep it.
npcmaker.help.field.appearance.skin_user: Use a real player's skin by their Minecraft name.
npcmaker.help.field.appearance.arms: Arm width: auto, wide (Steve) or slim (Alex).
npcmaker.help.field.appearance.scale: Size: 1 is normal, 0.5 is half, 2 is twice as big (0.25–4).
npcmaker.help.field.stats.health: Hit points. 20 is a player's 10 hearts.
npcmaker.help.field.stats.strength: Damage per hit with an empty hand (weapons add theirs).
npcmaker.help.field.stats.armor: Armour points, like a player's armour bar (0–30). Worn armour adds to it.
npcmaker.help.field.stats.speed: Walking speed. 0.3 is about a player's walk; 0.5 is fast.
npcmaker.help.field.stats.knockback_resi: 0 = normal knockback, 1 = can't be knocked back.
npcmaker.help.field.ai_template: A ready-made AI to start from. The NPC's own settings win over it.
npcmaker.help.field.ai_template.more: Templates fill in behaviour and AI rules you didn't set yourself. Changing a setting here overrides just that part.
npcmaker.help.field.ai_template.none: None: only what's set on this NPC.
npcmaker.help.field.ai_template.guard: Guard: stands watch, fights enemies of its factions, helps allies.
npcmaker.help.field.ai_template.townsfol: Townsfolk: wanders, flees danger, goes home at night.
npcmaker.help.field.ai_template.bandit: Bandit: attacks players, runs away when badly hurt.
npcmaker.help.field.ai_template.companio: Companion: follows its owner and fights for them.
npcmaker.help.field.behavior.movement: How the NPC moves when nothing else is going on.
npcmaker.help.field.behavior.movement.wa: Wander: strolls around within the wander radius of its home.
npcmaker.help.field.behavior.movement.pa: Patrol: walks the route set with the NPC Wand.
npcmaker.help.field.behavior.wander_radi: How far from home a wandering NPC may go, in blocks.
npcmaker.help.field.behavior.combat: How the NPC reacts to danger.
npcmaker.help.field.behavior.combat.guar: Guard: attacks enemies of its factions on sight and defends allies.
npcmaker.help.field.behavior.combat.aggr: Aggressive: attacks players and anything hostile to it.
npcmaker.help.field.behavior.flee: Run away and hide from danger, then come back (like villagers).
npcmaker.help.field.behavior.look_at_pla: Turn its head towards nearby players.
npcmaker.help.field.behavior.respawn: Come back at its home after dying.
npcmaker.help.field.behavior.respawn_sec: How long after dying it comes back, in seconds.
npcmaker.help.field.gear_slot: Click to pick an item (any mod), right-click to empty the slot.
npcmaker.help.field.gear_slot.more: Enchanted or renamed items: hold them and use "Use item in my hand" in the picker. Saving after gear changes re-equips every NPC using the template.
npcmaker.help.field.equipment.drop_chanc: Chance (0–1) that worn and held items drop when the NPC dies.
npcmaker.help.editor.inventory.grid: Click a slot to pick an item, right-click to remove, scroll to change the amount.
npcmaker.help.editor.inventory.grid.more: NPCs use what they carry: they drink healing potions and milk, eat food when hurt, switch to a bow with arrows, and place torches in dark spots. Shift+scroll changes the amount by 8.
npcmaker.help.editor.factions.row: Tick to make this NPC a member of the faction.
npcmaker.help.editor.factions.row.more: Members of a faction are friends; they help each other and never hurt each other. Factions can be allied or hostile to other factions, and players earn reputation with them.
npcmaker.help.editor.factions.edit: Edit this faction: name, colour, how it treats players and other factions.
npcmaker.help.editor.factions.create: Make a new faction (this NPC joins it).
npcmaker.help.field.sounds.ambient: Played now and then while the NPC is idle. Right-click to clear.
npcmaker.help.field.sounds.greet: Played when a player starts talking to the NPC.
npcmaker.help.field.sounds.hurt: Played when the NPC gets hurt (default: player hurt sound).
npcmaker.help.field.sounds.death: Played when the NPC dies (default: player death sound).
npcmaker.help.field.sounds.voice.sound: The blips played while the NPC's words type out in a conversation.
npcmaker.help.field.sounds.voice.pitch: How deep (0.5) or high (2) the talking blips are.
npcmaker.help.field.speech.bubbles: Let the NPC say lines above its head (idle, approach and warning lines).
npcmaker.help.field.speech.idle: Lines the NPC says now and then while players are near. One is picked at random.
npcmaker.help.field.speech.approach: Said once when a player comes near (then not again for that player for a while).
npcmaker.help.field.speech.interval_seco: About how often idle lines are said, in seconds (it varies a little).
npcmaker.help.field.effects.idle_pose: A pose the NPC holds while standing still (built in, or ★ your own animations). It stands up to walk.
npcmaker.help.field.effects.idle_pose.re: Read: looks down at a book in both hands.
npcmaker.help.field.effects.idle_emotes: Emotes played now and then while a player is near (tick as many as you like).
npcmaker.help.field.effects.emote_interv: About how often an idle emote plays, in seconds.
npcmaker.help.field.effects.greet_emote: Emote played when a player starts talking to the NPC.
Cheer: both arms up, with a little hop.
npcmaker.help.field.effects.aura: Particles always floating around the NPC. Right-click to clear.
npcmaker.help.field.effects.aura.more: Shown while players are within 32 blocks. A new aura starts gentle (one particle twice a second); the count and timing can be changed in the NPC file.
npcmaker.help.field.effects.on_greet: A burst of particles when a player starts talking to the NPC.
npcmaker.help.field.effects.on_hurt: A burst of particles when the NPC gets hurt.
npcmaker.help.field.effects.on_death: A burst of particles when the NPC dies.
npcmaker.help.field.effects.on_quest_giv: A burst of particles when a player takes one of this NPC's quests.
npcmaker.help.field.effects.on_quest_don: A burst of particles when a player finishes this NPC's quest near it.
npcmaker.help.field.preview_emote: Play the next emote on the preview model, to see what each one looks like.
npcmaker.help.editor.dialogue.conversati: The conversation file this NPC uses (shared by NPCs with the same template).
npcmaker.help.editor.dialogue.open: Open the conversation graph (or start one from the NPC's greeting).
npcmaker.help.editor.dialogue.open.more: Boxes are what the NPC says; arrows are the player's replies. Replies can end the conversation, loop back, give rewards, start quests and more. Save NPC changes first.
npcmaker.help.editor.quests.row: A quest this NPC gives. Click to open it in the quest builder.
npcmaker.help.editor.quests.new: Make a new quest given by this NPC.
npcmaker.help.editor.quests.other: Open any quest in the world in the quest builder.
npcmaker.help.editor.location.x: East–west position of the NPC's home.
npcmaker.help.editor.location.z: North–south position of the NPC's home.
npcmaker.help.editor.location.yaw: Which way the NPC faces, in degrees (0 = south, 90 = west, 180 = north, -90 = east).
npcmaker.help.editor.location.pitch: Head tilt: negative looks up, positive looks down (-90 to 90).
npcmaker.help.editor.location.move: Move the NPC's home to where you're standing.
npcmaker.help.editor.location.face: Turn the NPC to face you.
npcmaker.help.rules.drag: Drag to move this rule up or down. Rules are checked top to bottom.
npcmaker.help.rules.trigger: When: what makes this rule check. Click to step through, right-click to go back.
npcmaker.help.rules.trigger.player_near: Player near: a player is within the radius (in blocks).
npcmaker.help.rules.trigger.entity_near: Mob near: any creature is within the radius (narrow it with the condition).
npcmaker.help.rules.trigger.attacked: Attacked: the NPC was hurt in the last 3 seconds.
npcmaker.help.rules.trigger.ally_attacke: Ally attacked: a friendly NPC nearby was hurt in the last 3 seconds.
npcmaker.help.rules.trigger.health_below: Health below: the NPC's health is under the percentage.
npcmaker.help.rules.trigger.weather_is: Weather is: clear, rain or thunder.
npcmaker.help.rules.value: The trigger's setting: a radius in blocks, a health %, day/night or the weather.
npcmaker.help.rules.action: Then: what the NPC does. Click to step through, right-click to go back.
npcmaker.help.rules.action.attack: Attack: fights whoever triggered the rule.
npcmaker.help.rules.action.flee: Flee: runs away from the danger.
npcmaker.help.rules.action.go_home: Go home: walks back to its home spot.
npcmaker.help.rules.action.go_to: Go to: walks to the x y z you set.
npcmaker.help.rules.action.follow: Follow: follows whoever triggered the rule.
npcmaker.help.rules.action.look_at: Look at: turns to look at whoever triggered the rule.
npcmaker.help.rules.action.say: Say: one of your lines in a speech bubble.
npcmaker.help.rules.action.play_sound: Play sound: plays the sound you pick.
npcmaker.help.rules.action.emit_particle: Particles: a burst of the particles you pick.
npcmaker.help.rules.action.use_item: Use item: uses an item from its inventory (potion, food, milk…).
npcmaker.help.rules.action.place_block: Place block: places a block from its inventory (torches go in dark spots).
npcmaker.help.rules.action.run_command: Run command: runs a server command as the NPC.
npcmaker.help.rules.action.play_animatio: Play animation: plays an emote or pose.
npcmaker.help.rules.condition: If: an extra check that must also be true (optional). Click to step through.
npcmaker.help.rules.extra: What to say, play, use or go to, depending on the action.
npcmaker.help.rules.extra.text: Lines to say, separated by | (one is picked at random). Styling like italic works.
npcmaker.help.rules.extra.sound: Click to pick a sound (▶ to listen). Right-click to clear.
npcmaker.help.rules.extra.particle: Click to pick particles. Right-click to clear.
npcmaker.help.rules.extra.animation: Click to pick an emote or pose. Right-click to clear.
npcmaker.help.rules.extra.item: Click to pick the item (it must be in the NPC's inventory).
npcmaker.help.rules.extra.pos: Where to go: x y z, like 120 64 -35.
npcmaker.help.rules.extra.command: The command to run. {npc}, {npc_name}, {target} and {target_name} are filled in.
npcmaker.help.rules.cooldown: Seconds before this rule can fire again. Blank = automatic.
npcmaker.help.rules.add: Add a new rule at the bottom.
npcmaker.help.graph.title: The conversation being edited, and its file name.
npcmaker.help.graph.add_box: Add a new box (something the NPC says) to the canvas.
npcmaker.help.graph.save: Save the conversation (you'll pick who it applies to).
npcmaker.help.graph.save.more: "All using it" updates the conversation for every NPC that shares it. "Only this NPC" gives this NPC its own copy. Click twice to confirm.
npcmaker.help.graph.back: Back to the NPC editor. With unsaved changes, click twice to throw them away.
npcmaker.help.graph.scope.all: Update the conversation for every NPC using it.
npcmaker.help.graph.scope.only: Give only this NPC its own copy of the conversation.
npcmaker.help.graph.canvas: The canvas. Drag empty space or scroll to move around; click empty space to close the side panel.
npcmaker.help.graph.box: A box: something the NPC says. Click to edit it, drag to move it.
npcmaker.help.graph.box.more:
The first line shows here; "+2" means two more pages. Each » row below is a reply the player can pick.
A box with no replies ends the conversation after the NPC speaks.
npcmaker.help.graph.box.start: START: the conversation begins at this box.
npcmaker.help.graph.port: A reply's ●. Drag it onto a box to connect, or into empty space to make a new box. Right-click to end the conversation here.
npcmaker.help.graph.port.more:
Gold arrows go forward, teal arrows loop back to an earlier box, and a red END tag means picking this reply ends the conversation.
A gold ! before a reply means it hands out a quest.
npcmaker.help.graph.opener: This box can also start the conversation when its condition is true (set in the file).
npcmaker.help.graph.panel.name: The box's name, used by arrows. Type a new one and press ✓ to rename it everywhere.
npcmaker.help.graph.panel.make_start: Make the conversation start at this box.
npcmaker.help.graph.panel.delete: Delete this box (click twice). Replies that led here will end the conversation instead.
npcmaker.help.graph.panel.page: One page of what the NPC says. The player clicks to see the next page.
npcmaker.help.graph.panel.add_page: Add another page, so the NPC says more before the replies.
npcmaker.help.graph.panel.reply: What the player says when they pick this reply.
npcmaker.help.graph.panel.target: Where this reply leads: a box, or End. Click to step forward, right-click to step back.
npcmaker.help.graph.panel.if: Conditions: show this reply only when they're all true (quest state, items, flags…).
npcmaker.help.graph.panel.do: Actions: what happens when the player picks this reply (rewards, quests, animations…).
npcmaker.help.graph.panel.add_reply: Add another reply for the player (up to 9).
npcmaker.help.graph.sub.back: Back to the box's lines and replies.
npcmaker.help.graph.sub.entry: The kind of condition or action. Click to step through the kinds, right-click to go back.
npcmaker.help.graph.sub.field: This condition's or action's setting. Pickers open on click.
npcmaker.help.graph.do.give_item: Give item: gives the player the item (with enchantments, any mod).
npcmaker.help.graph.do.take_item: Take item: takes items from the player (pair it with a "Carries item" condition).
npcmaker.help.graph.do.change_reputation: Reputation: raises or lowers the player's reputation with a faction.
npcmaker.help.graph.do.start_quest: Start quest: starts the quest straight away.
npcmaker.help.graph.do.offer_quest: Offer quest card: shows the quest card with Accept / Decline.
npcmaker.help.graph.do.complete_objectiv: Tick objective: completes a "Ticked by dialogue" objective in a quest.
npcmaker.help.graph.do.abandon_quest: Drop quest: removes the quest from the player's journal.
npcmaker.help.graph.do.set_flag: Set flag: remembers something about this player (for conditions later).
npcmaker.help.graph.do.join_faction: Join faction: the player joins a faction.
npcmaker.help.graph.do.leave_faction: Leave faction: the player leaves a faction.
npcmaker.help.graph.do.become_companion: Become companion: the NPC starts following the player.
npcmaker.help.graph.do.dismiss_companion: Stop following: the NPC stops being the player's companion.
npcmaker.help.graph.do.play_sound: Play sound: plays a sound at the NPC.
npcmaker.help.graph.do.play_animation: Play animation: the NPC plays an emote or pose.
npcmaker.help.graph.do.particles: Particles: a burst of particles around the NPC.
npcmaker.help.graph.do.run_command: Run command: runs a server command ({player} = the player's name).
npcmaker.help.graph.if.flag: Has flag: the player has (or hasn't) got a flag set earlier.
npcmaker.help.graph.if.has_item: Carries item: the player has at least this many of an item.
npcmaker.help.graph.if.quest: Quest state: a quest is active, completed, not started, or can be started.
npcmaker.help.graph.if.faction_member: In faction: the player is (or isn't) a member.
npcmaker.help.graph.if.reputation: Reputation: the player's reputation with a faction is at least this.
npcmaker.help.graph.if.standing: Standing: the player is at least this standing (e.g. Friendly).
npcmaker.help.graph.if.can_join_faction: Can join faction: nothing stops the player joining it.
npcmaker.help.graph.if.is_companion: Is companion: this NPC is (or isn't) the player's companion.
npcmaker.help.graph.if.chance: Chance: true only some of the time (0.5 = half the time).
npcmaker.help.graph.if.can_edit: Builders only: only operators and creative builders see it.
npcmaker.help.quest.save: Save the quest. Quests are shared by the whole world.
npcmaker.help.quest.back: Back to where you came from. With unsaved changes, click twice to throw them away.
npcmaker.help.quest.section.details: Title, journal text, who gives it, and whether it can be repeated.
npcmaker.help.quest.section.requires: Who can get the quest: conditions a player must meet first.
npcmaker.help.quest.section.stage: A stage: a step of the quest with its objectives. Finish them all to move on.
npcmaker.help.quest.section.stage.more: Stages run in order. Finishing the last stage completes the quest and hands out the rewards. Click ✖ twice to delete a stage.
npcmaker.help.quest.section.addstage: Add another stage to the end of the quest.
npcmaker.help.quest.section.rewards: What the player gets for finishing: items, XP, reputation and more.
npcmaker.help.quest.section.choose: Pick-one reward: the player chooses ONE of these items at the end.
npcmaker.help.quest.title: The quest's name, shown on the card, journal and banners.
npcmaker.help.quest.description: The story text shown in the journal and on the quest card.
npcmaker.help.quest.giver: The NPC who gives the quest. It gets the gold ! above its head.
npcmaker.help.quest.repeatable: Can players do this quest again after finishing it?
npcmaker.help.quest.cooldown: For repeatable quests: real minutes to wait before doing it again.
npcmaker.help.quest.abandonable: Can players drop this quest from their journal?
npcmaker.help.quest.stage_text: Optional text shown above this stage's objectives ("Find the old mill").
npcmaker.help.quest.choose.slot: Click to pick an item, right-click to remove, scroll to change the amount.
npcmaker.help.quest.row.objective: An objective. Click the kind to step through them, right-click to go back.
npcmaker.help.quest.row.reward: A reward. Click the kind to step through them, right-click to go back.
npcmaker.help.quest.row.condition: A condition. Click the kind to step through them, right-click to go back.
npcmaker.help.quest.row.field: This entry's setting. Chips open pickers (right-click clears); boxes take typing.
npcmaker.help.quest.objective.talk: Talk to an NPC: right-click an NPC of that template.
npcmaker.help.quest.objective.kill: Kill: defeat mobs, faction members or NPCs (nearby players share kills).
npcmaker.help.quest.objective.collect: Collect: have this many of an item in your inventory.
npcmaker.help.quest.objective.deliver: Bring items: carry them to an NPC and talk to it; they're handed over.
npcmaker.help.quest.objective.reach: Go to a place: get within the radius of the spot ("Here" uses where you stand).
npcmaker.help.quest.objective.custom: Ticked by dialogue: completed by a conversation's "Tick objective" action.
npcmaker.help.quest.reward.item: Item: any item, with enchantments and from any mod.
npcmaker.help.quest.reward.xp: Experience: points, or levels if ticked.
npcmaker.help.quest.reward.reputation: Reputation: more (or less) standing with a faction.
npcmaker.help.quest.reward.join_faction: Join faction: the player becomes a member.
npcmaker.help.quest.reward.set_flag: Set flag: remembers something about the player for later conditions.
npcmaker.help.quest.reward.start_quest: Start next quest: chains straight into a follow-up quest.
npcmaker.help.quest.reward.command: Run command: runs a server command ({player} = the player's name).
npcmaker.help.quest.condition.quest: Quest state: another quest is completed, active, not started, or can start.
npcmaker.help.quest.condition.flag: Has flag: the player has (or hasn't) got a flag.
npcmaker.help.quest.condition.has_item: Carries item: the player has at least this many of an item.
npcmaker.help.quest.condition.faction_me: In faction: the player is (or isn't) a member.
npcmaker.help.quest.condition.reputation: Reputation: at least this much with a faction.
npcmaker.help.quest.condition.standing: Standing: at least this standing with a faction (e.g. Friendly).
npcmaker.help.quest.condition.can_join_f: Can join faction: nothing stops the player joining.
npcmaker.help.quest.condition.is_compani: Is companion: the giver is (or isn't) the player's companion.
npcmaker.help.quest.condition.chance: Chance: offered only some of the time.
npcmaker.help.quest.condition.can_edit: Builders only: only operators and creative builders can get it.
npcmaker.help.faction.name: The faction's name, shown to players.
npcmaker.help.faction.color: The faction's colour as a hex code, like #8B1E3F.
npcmaker.help.faction.hidden: Hide this faction from the players' Factions screen (secret societies, monsters).
npcmaker.help.faction.player_relation: How the faction treats players who aren't members and have normal reputation.
npcmaker.help.faction.relation.neutral: Neutral: leaves them alone unless provoked.
npcmaker.help.faction.hostile_below: Players at or below this reputation (-100 to 100) are treated as enemies.
npcmaker.help.faction.allied_above: Players at or above this reputation (-100 to 100) are treated as allies.
npcmaker.help.faction.mobs: Mobs that count as members (e.g. zombies in an Undead faction). Click to tick them.
npcmaker.help.faction.relation: How this faction sees the other one. Click to step through, right-click to go back.
npcmaker.help.faction.rival: Rival: players can't belong to both factions at once.
npcmaker.help.faction.save: Save the faction. Every NPC in it sees the change.
npcmaker.help.faction.back: Go back. With unsaved changes, click twice to throw them away.
npcmaker.help.picklist.search: Type to search by name or id.
npcmaker.help.picklist.row_multi: Click to tick or untick it, then press Done.
npcmaker.help.lines.line: One line the NPC can say. Styling like italic works.
npcmaker.help.itempicker.tabs: Creative tabs from the game and your mods. "…" holds items no tab shows.
npcmaker.help.itempicker.grid: Click an item to pick it. Search looks through everything.
npcmaker.help.itempicker.hand: Use the exact item in your hand (keeps enchantments, names and other details).
